object.name: evi_control_lpg_buchla
object.digest: Envelope and control circuit wrapper for voltage control of Rf
object.description: Analog modelled vactrol envelope and control circuit for the voltage control of the <o>evi_lpg_buchla</o>.gendsp frequency inlet. Also embedded in the MSP abstraction <o>evi.lpg~</o>.

constructor.inlets: ping, vactrol, vactrol, offset, scaler, sweep

inlets.name: ping
inlets.digest: Ping the control circuit. Once connected to an LPG (evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp) audio rate ping to attack the filter gate.

inlets.name: vactrol
inlets.digest: Vactrol envelope rise time (ping attack time) in ms.

inlets.name: vactrol
inlets.digest: Vactrol envelope fall time (ping decay time) in ms.

inlets.name: offset
inlets.digest: 0..1. Offset (add to) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

inlets.name: scaler
inlets.digest: 0..1. Scale (multiply) the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

inlets.name: sweep
inlets.digest: 0..1. Amount of sweep range of the voltage input to the LPG. Part of the control circuit that engages the voltage (frequency) of the filter/gate.

outlets.name: r_f
outlets.digest: Rf (frequency) voltage, typically to trigger an LPG (evi_lpg_buchla.gendsp) downstream.

outlets.name: vactrol
outlets.digest: Aux output of the initial envelope follower that begins the ping of the control circuit (LPG). Can be useful for synchronous downstream processing.

attributes.name: offsetsmooth
attributes.description: If > 0, smooths the 'offset' control (inlet 4) by this amount in ms.

attributes.name: response
attributes.description: Select 0, 1, 2. To quote the paper, '...it makes little difference'. But sometimes it does make a difference. This control switches between slow..long response times for the voltage input into the control circuit shaper.

attributes.name: scalersmooth
attributes.description: If > 0, smooths the 'scale' control (inlet 5) by this amount in ms.

attributes.name: sweepsmooth
attributes.description: If > 0, smooths the 'sweep' control (inlet 6) by this amount in ms.

attributes.name: vactrolcontroldamp
attributes.description: Low shelving filter damp, optionally maps between V_c and V_b (default bypassed). To quote the paper, '...it makes little difference'. 0 = no damping (default, bypassed), 1 = fully damped. Also see @vactrolcontrolhz.

attributes.name: vactrolcontrolhz
attributes.description: Low shelving filter frequency in Hz, optionally maps between V_c and V_b (default bypassed). To quote the paper, '...it makes little difference'. Also see @vactrolcontroldamp.

attributes.name: vactrolscalar
attributes.description: Vactrol Envelope Output Multiplier. Effectively gain the pinging envelope into the control circuit to accentuate the ping. Otherwise should be '1'.
